story:
God speaks to Moses from a burning bush and promises to be with him as he leads God's people. Grandpa Sol tells the story to Zara, Eli and Pip, with a sing-along song at the end. (Exodus 3-4)

Memory line: God is always with me!

Talk about it together:
Ages 2-3: What was burning but did not burn up? (A bush!)
Ages 4-8: What did God say to Moses? Why was Moses worried? What did God promise? When do we need to remember God is with us?
Prayer: Dear God, thank You for being with me everywhere I go. Amen.
Activity (5 minutes): Draw a bush with orange and yellow flames, and write "God is with me" around it.

🎵 Sing along with the lyrics:

[Verse 1]
Moses watched his sheep one day
Out on the mountain, far away
A little bush was burning bright
But it did not burn, what a sight!

[Chorus]
God is with me, God is with me
Everywhere I go
God is with me, God is with me
He is by my side, I know!

[Verse 2]
"Take your shoes off, Moses, please
This is holy ground," He said
Moses listened, and he knew
God was speaking, kind and true

[Chorus]
God is with me, God is with me
Everywhere I go
God is with me, God is with me
He is by my side, I know!

[Verse 3]
"Who am I?" he said, so small
"I will be with you through it all"
When I'm worried, when I'm scared
God is with me, He is there

[Chorus - lifted]
God is with me, God is with me
Everywhere I go
God is with me, God is with me
He is by my side, I know!

[Outro]
God is with me
God is with me!

#BibleStoriesForKids #Eliora
